newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea revokes Dong Ah's licence.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea revokes Dong Ah's licence.

text.p: South Korea's construction ministry has revoked Dong Ah Construction Industrial Co Ltd's licence to build steel-framed bridges, ministry officials said on Thursday.
"Dong Ah would be banned from receiving new orders to build steel-framed bridges," one official told Reuters.
The ministry found Dong Ah responsible for "mismanaging" construction of the steel-framed Songsu bridge, which collapsed in October 1994, killing 32 people.
"This would make it impossible for Dong Ah to win a bridge construction order in the future," said a construction analyst at Hannuri-Salomon Securities.
Dong Ah's bridge construction takes up less than seven percent of the company's total construction, he said.
Shares of Dong Ah closed down 1,400 won on Thursday at 17,900.
